| # | Action Title | Visual |
|---|-------------|--------|
| **1** | A 4-week exploratory meeting can unlock cross-entity AI research with zero budget commitment | Decision-tree diagram |
| **2** | AI agents are making economic decisions without empirical grounding—and the cost of inaction is losing research credibility | Bar chart (adoption trajectory) |

| **5** | Nyx Foundation's #1 Ethereum audit ranking demonstrates the blockchain security expertise this project requires | Credential badge/card |
| **6** | Real incentives and auditable logs differentiate this testbed from synthetic simulations and opaque corporate sandboxes | Comparison table (3-col) |
| **7** | Modular participation tiers let each entity engage at their comfort level with clear exit gates | Swimlane + timeline |
| **8** | Research outputs inform SGE's AI-in-education roadmap and Startale/Soneium's trust-infrastructure positioning | 3-column synergy map |
| **9** | Private chain design eliminates speculation risk; sandbox isolation converts harmful behaviors into research data | Layered security diagram |
| **10** | Explicit governance boundaries define what is automated, what requires human approval, and what is out of scope | Governance boundary table |
| **11** | 16M JPY prize pool and phased cost structure minimize financial risk while maximizing research leverage | Cost-benefit table |
| **12** | Next step: approve the exploratory meeting, designate owners, and align on research questions within 4 weeks | Timeline with milestones |
